_doc: Tuning for formable nations, national traits' companions (advisors) and missions. See docs/NATIONS.md. Effect names are the same as in traits.json.

forming._aiChance: monthly chance that an eligible AI country forms the nation

prestige._doc: Prestige bonus points (from forming nations and missions) are added to the 0-100 prestige score, at most 15 (BONUS_CAP in prestige.js); they fade by `decayMonth` of their value each month.

economy.name: Treasurer
economy.text: Runs the treasury and the customs service.

military.name: Marshal
military.text: Trains the officer corps and plans for war.

administration.name: Chief minister
administration.text: Keeps the administration honest and the provinces calm.

advisors._slots: advisor seats by government type (one advisor of each kind at most)
advisors._salary: monthly salary = (salaryBase + revenue x salaryRevenueShare) x skill, in billions; hiring costs hireMonths of salary
advisors._pool: candidates change every poolMonths months; the pool is drawn from the game seed, the country and the period, so looking at it never changes the game
advisors._death: monthly chance of death = deathBase x e^((age - 50) / deathScale)
